featured_reviews.name: Rohan Madkaikar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Cheaters.. Cold Liars.. Ungrateful.. Rudest person ( owner ) on planet earth..
couple of months ago i happened to visit the shop.. i needed a comb for my dog.. so i bought one steel and one plastic slicker brush ( which i was bit unsure about ). After reaching home I happened to check the slicker brush, it had really sharp edges and would have hurt my dog. Hence i called the number mentioned on google and spoke to lady owner to return the product and also i wanted to buy medicine for my dog as well .. the lady blindly refused to take it back saying, we don’t buy back accessories once sold.. on which i requested her that i don’t want my money back but instead it could be settled against the medicine i’m buying from her shop. For which she said kindly pay the medicine in full and handover the product to be returned to guy delivering the medicine . she will check the product condition and she will let me know how she can settle the returned product. So the guy came with the medicine and i paid them in full, as well as i returned the product to that same guy.
Hoping for some callback, I did wait for that whole day , i didn’t get any call back  and eventually it was all forgotten until today when I happened to cross that same shop, i realised i still haven’t still got any resolution over the returned product.
So I entered the shop first i checked if the slicker brush i returned was still there and to my surprise it was still there, and luckily the owner was present at the shop, i straightaway asked about the same by recollecting the whole scenario to the owner again, upon which the owner blindly refused stating that she hasn’t received the returned product yet and that she cant do anything about it. I was so confused, i told her that your shop guy has taken the product while against the delivery of the medicine… Upon which she said that he never returned the product to the shop, hence she cant help me with any refund or adjustments towards any product i wish to buy. I said the guy whom i returned the product was your appointed person and that it wasn’t my concern if he didn’t return the product to you, and that  she can call the delivery person and confirm the same in front of me, for which said something which really triggered me to another level, she said “ ohh he’s not been coming to work since last 2 months as he’s been possessed by some evil, and hence i wouldn’t call him.” Thats a lie!.. cant imagine what reasons they render just to avoid few bucks.

She is extremely rude, and despite of working in a service industry in todays world, you cant have such sick and unapologetic attitude.

Would definitely request every pet owner to think twice before giving any business to such shops.
They are just not worth it.

After 6 months i inquired about the paper work, to which i was advised its still coming, after a year again i was advised the paper work is still coming. Then was told the breeder was not answering the phone., I was further advised that he has friends in the area of where this breeder resides and that they are looking for the breeder as he does not know how to contact him. After 2 years of excuses i requested the breeders number to which he would not give. Ive then advised Posh Pets that i would take them to court for failing to provide the service they assured. Eventually I was given the name and number of the Dog breeder. I called the number of the person and yes the phone number was not connecting, however he was not difficult to find as he and his business are over the internet and on facebook with contact details of the business ect. As it turns out this person is a very well renowned and respected dog breeder. Ive contacted him and basically hes advised me that he has not sold any puppies to anyone by the name of Posh Pets in Bandra.
